points.name: 不仅如此/无论如何 & full-course review
points.explain: 不仅如此 ("not only that") adds another point on top of what was just said. 无论如何 ("no matter what") means a conclusion holds regardless of circumstances. The rest of this week's sentences review patterns from across the course: 只要...就..., 因为...所以..., 虽然...但是..., and 既然...就....

sentences.zh: 他很努力不仅如此他也很聪明
sentences.en: He works hard; not only that, he's also smart.
No matter what, I must succeed.

sentences.zh: 只要你努力就能实现梦想
sentences.en: As long as you work hard, you can realize your dream.

sentences.zh: 因为有希望所以不放弃
sentences.en: Because there is hope, [we] don't give up.

sentences.zh: 虽然困难但是我们不放弃
sentences.en: Although it's difficult, we don't give up.
